individual-data-points.explanation: Scatter plot where each of the n=141 samples is plotted individually, with marginal histograms showing full distributions.
X-Y scatter/dot plot of circadian vs noise components across many cell line/reporter combinations; scatter plots are exempt from the individual-points requirement.
Line/density plots of period and amplitude distributions; line plots are exempt from the individual-points requirement.
Box plots with individual sample ridge-length values (Per2-Luc and Bmal1-Luc dots) overlaid on each box.
Polar histograms display full probability distributions of phase differences, not group means requiring individual-point overlay.
Polar histogram of subtype-averaged phase differences; a distribution plot, exempt from the individual-points requirement.
Single illustrative example trace with fitted model, not an averaged summary plot.
Scatter plot of amplitude vs decay rate for individual samples (n=117); scatter plots are exempt from the individual-points requirement.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Scatter plot and histograms show individual data without error bars.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Data represents the mean +/- s.d. of 6 samples per reporter (n = 2 biological replicates a technical triplicates or duplicates [HCC1806 Per2-Luc, n = 5])
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars shown and explicitly defined as mean +/- s.d. in the caption.
Density curves show distributions without error bars.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: with the bottom and top edges of the boxes representing the 25th and 75th percentiles, respectively. Extending whiskers represent data points within 1.5 times the interquartile range from lower and upper quartile. Median values are marked by red horizontal lines, and outliers by red crosses.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Box plot elements (box, whiskers, median, outliers) are fully defined in the caption.
Polar histograms show probability distributions without error bars.
Polar histogram shows averaged distribution without error bars.
Illustrative single example trace, no error bars present.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Error bars represent the standard deviation of the fitted parameters, reflecting their uncertainty as determined by the fitting process.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars present and clearly defined in the caption as standard deviation of fitted parameters.
